text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Hanshin J.F. has finally arrived.<n>This huge
stage will be Mejiro<n>Dober's first G1 race, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...All right.
choice_data_list: You don't seem nervous at all.
You don't seem nervous at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Are you saying I should be? Well, Iam a little surprised at how calm I am.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'm a little surprised by how<n>calm I feel.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to do well today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to do well today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well enough to believe that I actually<n>stand a
chance in the Tiara tour!
choice_data_list: You have your promise with Bright to keep.
You have your promise with Bright to keep.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Eyes aglow with determination, she<n>seems to be
shaking more out of<n>excitement than anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I'm sure she's going to do great out<n>there!
choice_data_list: Get out there and bring home the win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I don't need you telling me to do that.<n>Anyway, I'm
off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I will. See you soon!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Prepare to be dazzled, everyone! I'll<n>show you
shining brilliance like<n>you've never seen before!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Prepare to be dazzled, everyone! I'll<n>show you
shining brilliance like<n>you've never seen before!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wow... It's hard to believe this is<n>Pearl's first big
race too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I guess that's no surprise coming<n>from someone
who's always<n>boasting that the world is her
oyster.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I can't lose out to her in spirit,<n>though! I'm going to
put myself out<n>there and be just as bold!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I like the look in your eyes,<n>Dober. Filled with
determination and<n>competitive spirit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pearl...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What a splendid day to pit our<n>budding potentials
against each other.<n>It's nearly showtime!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to give this race everything<n>I've got, and
I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
They're about to step up to the gate<n>for the
Hanshin J.F.! Who will emerge<n>as the junior
Goddess?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Those cheers... So this is what a G1<n>feels like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I can't stop shaking... The track feels<n>even bigger
than usual.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(The soles of my feet feel strangely<n>hot too, like
they're absorbing heat<n>from the turf.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'll be okay. It'll all be okay.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm calm. I can do this. I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I can run!
